title: Mediatorship of Christ
definition: The mediatorship of Christ means that Jesus is the one mediator between God and humanity, reconciling sinners to God.
summary: Jesus alone brings sinners to God.
christFocus: Christ mediates by His person and work as fully God, fully man, Savior, Priest, and Lord.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Sin separates people from God. Humanity cannot create its own way back. Christ alone stands as mediator because He is fully God and fully man.

As mediator, Jesus reveals God to humanity and brings humanity to God through His sacrifice, righteousness, intercession, and covenant work.

There is no other mediator of salvation. Access to God comes through Christ alone.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often seek access to God through religion, morality, saints, leaders, or spiritual experiences. The mediatorship of Christ matters because only Jesus can bring sinners to God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Come to God through Christ with confidence. Do not place ultimate trust in any mediator other than the Savior Scripture reveals.
